Practised speed using distance ÷ time: 300 ÷ 10 = 30 m/s.
Practised acceleration using a = (v − u)/t, including 30 m/s to 20 m/s.
Identified a negative sign for slowing down but continued to treat acceleration as only speeding up.

Teach-back was not passed.
